definitions.explanation: Having the ability to endure hardship, pain, or difficulty without complaining.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{我慢強|がまんづよ}い{人|ひと}だ。
{我慢強|がまんづよ}く{待|ま}っていたら、やっとチャンスが{来|き}た。
examples.english: By waiting patiently, my chance finally came.

examples.japanese: この{仕事|しごと}は{我慢強|がまんづよ}くないとできない。
examples.english: You can't do this job unless you're patient.

notes:
FORMS:
{我慢|がまん} (patience/endurance) + {強|つよ}い (strong)
- {我慢強|がまんづよ}くない - not patient (negative)
- {我慢強|がまんづよ}くて - patient and... (te-form)
- {我慢強|がまんづよ}かった - was patient (past)
- {我慢強|がまんづよ}く + verb - patiently (adverb)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {我慢強|がまんづよ}く{待|ま}つ - to wait patiently
- {我慢強|がまんづよ}く{取|と}り{組|く}む - to work on persistently
- {我慢強|がまんづよ}い{性格|せいかく} - patient personality

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {粘|ねば}り{強|づよ}い - tenacious, persistent
- {辛抱強|しんぼうづよ}い - patient, forbearing
- {根気強|こんきづよ}い - persevering

USAGE:
{我慢強|がまんづよ}い emphasizes enduring hardship; {粘|ねば}り{強|づよ}い emphasizes not giving up.
